items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: I didn't get a chance very much to hear him play. But you during those years they used to love to hear me play, /can safely say I've got some of J.J.'s records right now, and marvel at his style

ctx.x: Let's see. You were with Harlan Leonard, you were in Kansas City, Tadd Dameron was there, he was arranging, composing at that time, he had his own band at that time -- or was he doing work for other people?

No, he was doing a lot of writing. and that was the band that was there one time, one week, a few days with Snookum Russell In that band was Fats Navarro, one of the greats also. He passed away young. And J. J. Johnson, and J. J. right now, I don't know of his fame now, he's one of the greats now, but and I didn't get a chance very much to hear him play. But you during those years they used to love to hear me play, /can safely say I've got some of J.J.'s records right now, and marvel at his style, the way he…
Yeh, you didn't get much chance to hear him though at that time?
